legend: SDH-deficient gastrointestinal stromal tumours commonly demonstrate a multinodular, multilobulated, or plexiform growth pattern. Often lobules of tumour are separated by fibrous bands or non-neoplastic smooth muscle.

SDHB IHC shows negative staining. It is emphasized that for SDHB immunohistochemistry to be considered interpretable there should be granular cytoplasmic expression in the non-neoplastic cells which act as internal postive controls

Commonly demonstrate a multinodular, multilobulated or plexiform growth pattern. Often lobules of tumour are separate by fibrous bands or non-neoplastic smooth muscle. The tumour is composed predominantly of epithelioid cells within a rich capillary network.
